examples.text: Caring for a loved one with a chronic illness inevitably involves self-sacrifice.

glosses: The act of making the ultimate sacrifice of giving up one's life for a cause.

examples.text: His brave self-sacrifice won him a posthumous medal, but I think he'd have preferred to receive it in person.

(Two railwaymen lost their lives in 1944 when a wagon in an ammunition train caught fire and blew up, an even worse disaster was averted however.)
